en: Color-printed vintage view of an Italian square showing historic buildings around an open piazza. A tall crenellated clock tower (Torre Grande) dominates the right side, with a domed church structure on the left and a large fountain in front of the central building. There is a printed caption at the bottom and vertical handwritten message on the right margin.
